Born-on-graph posts render here first, under the staging profile only (`quarto render --profile
staging`; design 13753cbf (1)) — the public profile never sees this tree, and nothing under
`drafts/` but this page is committed. Publish state lives on the graph, not in the site: the
lists below are projected from the `publish_state` facts by `notes-staging-index --write`
(item 140981e9) and regenerate from the graph — never edit them by hand.

## Works — promotion condition

A work's chapter pages reach the public site only when **every** chapter unit of the work is born
at draft or better (ruling a7ca900d): the whole work replaces the pre-graph notes at once.

{{< include lists/_works.md >}}

## Drafts

Born, not yet reviewed. Candidates once their work's condition holds.

:::{#drafts}
:::

## Reviewed

A person read the page in staging and asserted `reviewed`.

:::{#reviewed}
:::

## Published

Cleared for the outward emit (`emit-post`).

:::{#published}
:::

## Fixtures

Pages kept for the graph mechanics they exercise — **never promotion candidates** (ruling 2b8a93a5).
They render here so their behaviour can be checked, and nowhere else.

:::{#fixtures}
:::

## Retired

Abandoned pages, closed with their provenance kept. Reopening is an explicit human `--supersede`.

:::{#retired}
:::

## Multi-active (supersession gaps)

A page listed here holds more than one active `publish_state` — a gap to close with an explicit
supersede, shown rather than hidden.

:::{#multi-active}
:::
